#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cstring>

using namespace std;

const int MOD = 1000000007;

class Solver {
public:
    int solve(int n) {
        vector<vector<vector<int>>> dp(2 * n + 1, vector<vector<int>>(2 * n + 1, vector<int>(2, 0)));
        dp[0][0][0] = 1;
        int depth = 1;
        while (depth <= 2 * n) {
            int opened = depth & 1;
            while (opened <= depth) {
                if (opened - 1 >= 0) {
                    dp[depth][opened][0] += dp[depth - 1][opened - 1][1];
                    dp[depth][opened][1] += dp[depth - 1][opened - 1][0];
                }
                if (opened + 1 <= n) {
                    dp[depth][opened][0] += dp[depth - 1][opened + 1][1];
                    dp[depth][opened][1] += dp[depth - 1][opened + 1][0];
                }
                dp[depth][opened][0]++;
                dp[depth][opened][0] %= MOD;
                dp[depth][opened][1] %= MOD;
                opened += 2;
            }
            depth++;
        }
        return dp[2 * n][0][1];
    }
};

int main() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    Solver solver;
    int ans = solver.solve(n);
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
